policy.rule: Large training corpora are referenced by immutable manifests, hashes, licenses, and reproducible fetch recipes; they are not vendored into the repository. A trained model is never evidence that the exact corpus which produced it is available.
policy.promotion_rule: A dataset may be called HASH_PINNED only when every referenced shard has an immutable locator and cryptographic hash. A model may be called exactly reproducible only when architecture, complete raw/derived data lineage, generation and filtering recipe, trainer revision, hyperparameters, and checkpoint selection are all pinned.
